title: The Sun is a star
examples: Teacher, is the Sun a planet?
How far away is the Sun from Earth?
Why is the Sun so hot?

explain.say: The Sun is the star closest to Earth.
It gives us light and heat every day.
The Sun is very hot and very bright.
You must never look directly at the Sun.
The Sun helps plants grow using its light.
A common mistake is thinking the Sun is a giant light bulb.

draw.text: Mistake: Sun is not a bulb

faq.a: No, the Sun is a star. Stars are giant balls of hot gas that make their own light and heat.
asks: What is the Sun made of?

faq.q: How far away is the Sun?
faq.a: The Sun is very close to Earth in our solar system. It is the center of our neighborhood in space.
It is hot because it is a star. Stars burn fuel inside them, which makes a lot of heat and light.

faq.q: Can I look at the Sun with my bare eyes?
faq.a: No, you should never look directly at the Sun. It is too bright and can hurt your eyes badly.
asks: Is it safe to look at the Sun?
What should I use to see the Sun?

faq.a: A star is a huge ball of burning gas. Our Sun is the star that we live near.
asks: Are all stars like the Sun?
What is the difference between a star and a planet?

facts: It is the star closest to Earth.
It provides us with light and heat.
It is very bright and hot.

quiz.say: What is the Sun mainly known for being?
quiz.why: The Sun is a star because it makes its own light and heat.

wrong.1: Planets go around a star; they do not make their own light.
wrong.2: The Moon orbits Earth and only reflects light from the Sun.
wrong.3: Comets are made of ice and dust and orbit the Sun.

quiz.say: If you look at the Sun without protection, what might happen?
quiz.why: Looking directly at the Sun is dangerous for your eyes.

wrong.0: It is not good because it is too bright for your eyes.
wrong.1: It is not okay because it can cause serious eye damage.
wrong.2: There is no neutral way to look at the Sun.

quiz.say: What do plants use from the Sun to help them grow?
quiz.why: Plants use sunlight for energy in a process called photosynthesis.

wrong.0: Wind moves things, but it does not provide the energy for plant growth.
wrong.1: Soil gives nutrients, but sunlight provides the necessary energy.
wrong.3: Water helps plants, but sunlight gives them the energy to grow.
